critique: The ink-black crow, articulated robed puppeteers, and rod-held rocket staged against a blazing pop-cosmic lantern create a surprising, joyful fusion of ancient shadow theatre and retro spaceflight. The concentric orbit rings, sunburst wedges, halftone grain, and visible control rods compete around the central disc; selectively dimming the CSS rings during key puppet gestures would sharpen the narrative silhouettes and give the crow’s orbit more dramatic impact.
